caveats: Replaces the version shipped on 2026-08-04, whose TAIL came out as a detached black fin floating beside the body, and whose mouth was open on a red tongue: the input caught the animal mid-miaow with its tail behind it.

Seven cat photographs were generated across two rounds and five failed. What separates them is posture, not breed or lighting: a cat SITTING UPRIGHT and cut out on a plain ground works, and a cat lying down or walking comes out as torn ribbons. A tabby on a black background failed differently again, with the background matted into the object as a black cape.
